title: Skyroot becomes India’s first spacetech unicorn after $60 million round
summary: Hyderabad’s Skyroot Aerospace crossed unicorn status after a $60 million round at about $1.1 billion, led with Sherpalo and GIC, as it prepared Vikram-1 orbital missions from Infinity Campus.

title: India’s first space-tech unicorn emerges as Skyroot gears up for orbital launch
summary: TechCrunch’s report on Skyroot’s unicorn round and the Hyderabad company’s path to a private orbital launch.

title: Skyroot invites bids to raise $200 million at a $2 billion valuation
summary: Inc42 reported Skyroot asked investors to bid into a ~$200 million raise at a $2 billion ask, months after the $1.1 billion unicorn round. Skyroot had not commented at publish time.

title: Microsoft, Salesforce eye Darwinbox buyout ahead of its planned IPO
summary: Mint reported Microsoft, Salesforce and ADP had approached Darwinbox’s board about a buyout while the KKR-backed firm prepared for a possible IPO. Darwinbox denied stake-sale talks and said it remains on an IPO path.

title: Darwinbox launches Cortex, an AI-native HCM platform
summary: Official announcement: Darwinbox Cortex rebuilds the HCM stack for AI, launching with pilot customers and partners including Microsoft, Slack and Glean.

title: Hyderabad startup funding soars in H1 2026 as Delhi and Mumbai dip
summary: Inc42’s H1 2026 funding report: Hyderabad startups raised over $226 million across 22 deals (about +45% YoY), led by Skyroot’s unicorn round, with Dhruva Space and Recykal also cited.
